emails.subject: CounselConnect is ready for your case team messages
emails.body:
Hello Rosa,

Your LegalPath Companion connection to Daniel Okafor's team is active. When a legal question seems to need attorney input, Companion can prepare and send a short summary of a notice along with your preferred call-back number. The intake paralegal team reviews incoming messages during office hours and routes urgent matters to the on-duty attorney.

If a marshal, sheriff, or anyone else is locking you out or removing your belongings, call the court's emergency housing line or 911 instead of using CounselConnect.

- Riverside Senior Tenant Legal Aid

emails.subject: After your hearing - glad you reached us quickly
emails.body:
Dear Rosa,

I am glad Companion reached us quickly before your hearing. Because of that, we were able to appear and get the case adjourned. Please keep using Companion for everyday support, for helping you decide what to ask us, and for looping us in when a situation seems to need attorney review.

Warmly,
Daniel Okafor
